ValidationRule.description: For IME Standard opportunities, must specify at least one competitor if the reason lost is 'Competitor Solution'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( IM_Reason_Lost__c, 'Competitors Solution'), IM_Has_Competitors__c = FALSE, RecordTypeId = '01280000000UDKJ' || RecordTypeId = "01280000000UEMI" || RecordTypeId = "01280000000UEfu", NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At least one competitor must be specified if the Reason Lost is 'Competitors Solution'
